title: Kubernetes Pod Health
description: Check Kubernetes pods and report pods that are not Ready or Running.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

NAMESPACE="${1:-default}"

if ! command -v kubectl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "ERROR: kubectl is not installed." >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "Pods in namespace: $NAMESPACE"
kubectl get pods -n "$NAMESPACE"

echo
echo "Pods not in Running phase:"
BAD=$(kubectl get pods -n "$NAMESPACE" --no-headers |
    awk '$3 != "Running" {print}')

if [[ -n "$BAD" ]]; then
    echo "$BAD"
    exit 1
fi

echo "OK: All pods are Running."
